'''Chup-Chup''' was a [[Talz/Legends|Talz]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] had a father named [[Bama Vook]]. Chup-Chup was kidnapped by [[Bartokk]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] under the employ of [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
